title: "tapped" missing from entering permanents and tokens (13 cards)
body:
The text says the permanent or token enters tapped, but the encoding has it enter untapped:

- Search or reveal: Dire-Strain Rampage (first branch), Hew the Entwood (lands), Nissa's Pilgrimage, Pir's Whim, Settle the Wreckage, Sméagol, Helpful Guide, Viewpoint Synchronization
- Return or exile: Sandman, Shifting Scoundrel, Thieves' Auction
- Tokens: Bottle-Cap Blast, Corpseweft, The Western Cloud
- Sandstorm Crasher: "tapped and attacking" token encoded neither tapped nor attacking

Viewpoint Synchronization also finds two cards instead of three and puts them into the graveyard instead of onto the battlefield.
